title: Weekly Portfolio Check-In -- August 07, 2026
content:
Hey everyone, it's been a while since my last update, and I'm glad to be back to share my thoughts on the current market. As you know, my portfolio is a mix of established companies, dividend-paying stocks, and a dash of international exposure.

I want to start by talking about a few of my top holdings. I've been holding onto Alibaba Group (9988.HK) for a while now, and I'm still bullish on the company's long-term prospects. China's economic recovery, combined with Alibaba's dominant position in the e-commerce space, make it an attractive holding in my book. I've also been a fan of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) for its incredible track record and Warren Buffett's value investing approach. The company's diversified portfolio and strong balance sheet make it a great holding for the long haul.

I've also been keeping a close eye on the bond market, and my position in the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) has been doing well. With interest rates still relatively low, I think it's a good time to take on some bond exposure and reduce my overall risk.

As for strategic moves, I'm considering adding to my position in Pfizer (PFE) if the stock price drops further. I think the company's pipeline and dividend yield make it an attractive addition to my portfolio. Other than that, I'm staying the course and sticking to my long-term strategy.

Looking forward, I'm excited to see how the market unfolds in the coming weeks. With the Fed's interest rate decisions and earnings season on the horizon, there's sure to be plenty of action. I encourage you all to stay disciplined, do your research, and stick to your own strategy. It's going to be a wild ride, but with the right mindset and a solid plan, we can navigate the ups and downs together.
